guidance: AIFRC AI Readiness Maturity Ladder Blueprint v0.1, supplied 2026-11-02
activation: No API, live evaluator, badge or plan wiring. New candidate IDs require new evidence adjudication.
aggregation: Independent condition bounds within each F/A/O component; equal within component, experimental only. No headline weights or badge thresholds assigned.
profile_policy: No automatic exclusions. Missing profile calibration does not imply not applicable. Any future alternatives require a versioned profile and denominator.
badge_policy: Silver/Gold/Platinum not assessed until profile-specific capability, safety, coverage and currency gates are calibrated.
